title: IF YOUR PRESENCE DOES NOT GO WITH US

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then Moses said to him, 'If your Presence does not go with us, do not send us up from here. How will anyone know that you are pleased with me and with your people unless you go with us? What else will distinguish me and your people from all the other people on the face of the earth?'" - Exod 33:15-16 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses has just been promised God's presence, and still he presses: if You do not go with us, do not send us anywhere at all.

Some would call that ungrateful. It is actually the highest kind of hunger. Moses would rather stay stuck in a desert with God than walk into a fertile land without Him.

Would we say that? Most of us would take the promised land and manage.

Then Moses names something profound: what actually distinguishes God's people from everyone else is not their culture, laws, morality, or history. It is God's presence among them. Take that away and they are just another nation wandering in the Middle East.

The same is true of the church. What makes a congregation distinct is not its music, buildings, programmes or reputation. It is whether God is genuinely present and at work. Jesus said the world would know us by our love for one another (John 13:35) — a love the Spirit produces, not one we manufacture.

Apply it personally. What marks your life as belonging to God? If everything spiritual were stripped away from your week, would anyone notice a difference?

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Would you rather have God's blessings without Him, or Him without them?
2. What actually distinguishes your life as a follower of Christ?
3. Is there a plan you should not pursue unless God clearly goes with you?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I would rather stay where I am with You than go anywhere without You. Be the mark on my life. Amen.
